patch.summary: HubSpot orientation: what it is, who uses it, workflows, capabilities, pricing shape, limits, and alternatives — informational entry before the full SoftwareGlimpse evaluation.

blocks.body: HubSpot is AI-powered customer platform with free forever CRM, plus paid Smart CRM seats and Sales/Marketing/Service hubs for growing teams.. This page orients you on what it is and who it fits — not a scored review.
bullets: Problem space: Choose HubSpot if you want a credible free CRM today and a path into a broader marketing/sales/service platform without migrating data later.
Often shortlisted when: SMB and mid-market teams wanting free CRM now and room to expand into hubs later

items.body: Choose HubSpot if you want a credible free CRM today and a path into a broader marketing/sales/service platform without migrating data later.

blocks.title: What HubSpot is NOT intended for

items.title: Limit 1
items.body: Smart CRM / Customer Platform seats and Sales Hub seats are separate ladders with different list prices; buying 'HubSpot' often means mixing Free CRM, Smart CRM seats, and hub seats.

items.title: Limit 2
items.body: Sales Hub Professional starts at list pricenth per seat on the Product & Services Catalog and the Sales product page (re-checked 2026-08-18). HubSpot’s Sales pricing page also shows list price billed annually vs list price monthly, plus required Professional onboarding (list price). Starter marketing prices show new-customer discounts (*).

items.title: Limit 3
items.body: Full GTM stack (Marketing Hub, Service Hub, etc.) is sold as additional hubs with their own seat/contact pricing — not included in Free CRM alone.

items.title: Limit 4
items.body: Administration and packaging complexity rise sharply once multiple Professional/Enterprise hubs and seat types (Core vs Sales seats) are combined.

items.title: Limit 5
items.body: Hub/seat packaging complexity versus single-product CRMs

items.title: Limit 6
items.body: Sales Hub Professional annual vs monthly display (list price billed annually vs list price monthly on HubSpot’s Sales pricing page; catalog list list price)
